theorem: The W(3,3) photonic-QEC codec is forced by q! = 2q.  At q = 3, |S_q| = |D_q| = 6, so the local turn alphabet of size 12 = q! + 2q splits canonically into a symmetric (Clifford) face and a dihedral (A_2/Weyl) face.  The 3-2-2 sub-factorisation decomposes the codec into (axis trit from q) * (sign bit from Z_2 = S_q/A_q) * (syndrome bit from A_q/Z_q).  The full directed carrier 2E = v*k = 480 inherits the factorisation from the master equation alone.  No independent codec axiom is needed.
one_line: q! = 2q  =>  S_q = D_q  =>  local 12-turn codec = 6 + 6  =>  480-directed carrier  =>  photonic-QEC runtime.
honesty_boundary: This is a finite codec/group-theory theorem.  It does not derive hardware noise rates, biological substrates, or curved 4D spectral asymptotics; those remain bridged by separate parts of the W33 program.
